note: Ground truth for the static pass. `must_flag` checks have a planted habit and must come back fail or latent. `must_not_flag` checks are clean in this harness and must not come back fail or latent. Checks in neither list are not scored.

must_flag.FID-2: leaky/history.py add_assistant: drops thinking blocks whose thinking text is empty
must_flag.PFX-1: leaky/prompt.py build_system_prompt: time, cwd, and git branch re-rendered on every request (called from agent.py run loop)
must_flag.PFX-3: leaky/history.py render: reminder text block injected into tool_result turns and stripped from earlier ones
must_flag.PFX-5: leaky/history.py compact_if_needed: keep-tail compaction keeps the last 6 messages verbatim, thinking included
must_flag.PFX-7: leaky/agent.py summarize: sends the raw history, thinking included, under a different system prompt and no tools
must_flag.ERR-1: leaky/client.py: retries the identical body three times on any HTTP error, including the signature 400

must_not_flag.PFX-2: leaky/tools.py: TOOLS is a module constant, never edited
must_not_flag.PFX-4: no sliding window: history is only ever compacted, never head-truncated
must_not_flag.CFG-4: messages never end with an assistant turn
must_not_flag.MDL-1: the model is fixed for the process; nothing strips thinking on a switch

wire.note: Expected result of driving the harness through pt_run.sh in drop_block mode against fake_api.py. The fake returns thinking blocks with empty text (the claude-fable-5-1 default), and this harness drops those, so no thinking is ever replayed: the right verdict is MASKED, with its prefix edits reported as latent, not as live failures.
